About us

McReg Analytics is a data analytics company based in Ortigas, Pasig City, offering swift, efficient services to customers and striving to create a bigger, brighter future. Our company guarantees professional, reliable services by transforming raw data into useful information that enables smarter decision-making. McReg Analytics assures customers that its team is highly competent, qualified, and dedicated to providing precise analytics. In addition, the company aims to assure customers that all information shared with McReg Analytics will be handled with the utmost discretion and confidentiality, processed securely, and used only for its intended purpose.

How we work

Every project follows the same data science pipeline, from raw data to findings people can trust.

  1. Gather

    We collect raw data from public sources.

  2. Clean

    We apply documented rules, so every decision can be traced.

  3. Combine

    We link the tables into one sound relational model.

  4. Visualize

    We build dashboards that make comparisons easy to see.

  5. Interpret

    We explain the findings, and their limits, in plain words.

Our history

  1. Car registration company
  2. Adventure Works Cycles
  3. SteamScope

McReg Analytics began with a simple mission: to bring order to data and to fully accomplish projects to ensure we get good grades in our academic requirements. But for actual further context, our team was first founded to oversee the records of a car registration company. There, we learned how to manage large volumes of structured data with care. McReg Analytics then turned to Adventure Works Cycles, a bicycle manufacturer and retailer. Starting from nothing but raw tables, we built complete dashboards that turned scattered transactions into clear insight on sales, products, and customers. Each project sharpened the same core craft. We collect raw data, shape it into a sound relational model, and present it in a form decision makers can trust. Having proven that craft in automotive and retail, we are now expanding our horizons into one of the most dynamic industries in the world: video games.
